It protects no password or secret and does not establish OS-root trust.

reviewed_findings.justification: Reviewed false positive: the SHA-1 digest of public X.509 certificate DER is an Authenticode report thumbprint. Built-in signature and chain validation use the certificate identities, parsed public keys and signatures rather than the thumbprint. PE and optional MSI can expose it to custom rules. The Mach-O consumer shares ASN.1 parsing and discards the thumbprint.
